overview.description: The ARIA Opportunities ETF (ARIA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF targeting undervalued companies from around the world using fundamental research and analytical tools. The fund also employs an options overlay to generate additional income. ARIA was launched on Aug 7, 2026 and is issued by Aria.
